title: Mit-Bestand Demonstrator CDN Redeploy Readiness
description: Get the mit-bestand demonstrator ready to be redeployed on a CDN as fast as possible: the static release build must succeed and every app (all eight panes) must run from the static bundle. Bugs are acceptable for this redeploy. Fall back to native tools if the shared work fleet mechanism does not work.
summary: CDN archive ready: .cache/deploy/site-20261125T134801Z.tar.gz (597 MB, 1,815 files, SHA256SUMS), byte-identical to the site verified by the official static matrix. All eight apps run in English and German; 10 of 16 strict boots pass. Aussuchen and Bearbeiten fail only on one leftover debug console line, Generator's 3D preview is empty. Koordinator, Aggregator, Bearbeiten and Verfolgen were re-pointed through runtimeVariant (Bearbeiten stays on the bundled guest) and eight cad and process extensions are withheld. Stale shard worker and surface wasm republished. No guest was rebuilt: the demonstrator and process finals exceed the 4,096 MB link budget and the policy was left unchanged. Details: 📊️status-2026-11-25.md.
